If you’ve been struggling with your IELTS writing, or been stuck at a specific band mark, then look no further. I’ve helped hundreds if not thousands achieve their IELTS writing goals, and you’re no exception! 

I offer 2 kinds of lessons for both General and Academic:

1)IELTS Writing Lessons 

In these lessons, I will teach you all about the different question types, the requirements of the tasks, how marks are given, and tips on how to get the band mark you are aiming for. I will go in depth into the marking criteria. This will give you a clear idea exactly what you need to do to get the band mark you want. I also clarify the most common mistakes that are made that limit the band mark of most students.

2)Feedback on Writing

In these lessons, I ask for writing 2 days in advance, 2-4 written tasks, task 1s or 2s. I correct the writing for grammatical and lexical mistakes before the lesson, and throughout the lesson I clarify the mistakes made in all 4 criteria (TA, CC, LR, and GRA) in accordance with the public band descriptors, which is a public document shared by IELTS that explains the requirements. I give advice on how to improve, and further study. 

In a 1 hour lesson, I can give feedback on 2-3 written tasks. In 30 minutes. Any unfinished tasks can be covered in the following lesson.

After the lesson

After the lesson, I send a message with a summary of the main points made in the lesson, and for the feedback I send a document with a correction of the grammatical and lexical mistakes, and highlighted parts for the other types of mistakes. I also send resources for further study.

Want a lesson?

Send me a message explaining your goals, previous experience with the IELTS exam, difficulties, and if you want a feedback lesson, send me 2-3 written tasks from the Cambridge examination books 5-13 at least 2 days in advance so that I can check your writing. Humans have EVOLVED to absorb languages, making links with everything around them, children learn so much more when they are not focussed on learning!

I like to teach in a way that models correct language usage organically, introducing vocabulary and language forms indirectly, in the same way that parents teach their own children their mother tongue. 

Over many years I have learned that this is by far the most effective way to teach children to speak natural sounding English effortlessly and without fear, allowing them to use and adapt the language they know to communicate effectively, effortlessly gaining confidence and language fluidity!
teacher_info.teaching_style:

We will read some level appropriate material together, and then talk and answer questions about it.  I have books about nearly everything, the most important thing to me is that the student is INTERESTED, listening and talking whilst engaged in the SUBJECT rather than just thinking that they are learning English!

We will practise any pronunciation issues as they arise, we may do silly exercises, singing or tongue twisters.  We may play games to practise spelling or a specific language/grammar point.

I am always especially happy when students unconsciously correct themselves whilst concentrating on winning a game!
